t_advice_summary_textbox.text: The gnomes always appear in pairs of certain colours and one will lead you to a dark forest and the other to a light forest. You should try memories which gnomes leads to which forest and try to alternate so that you can get the most points. The shape and size of the gnomes in irrelevant.

vb_textbox.text: The gnomes appear in fixed pairs and each one leads to one of two forests, a light forest and a dark one. Orange & Brown, Pink & Green, Yellow & Red and Purple & Blue. The aim is to work out which forest currently has the most mushrooms and try to go to that forest until you notice that there are no more mushrooms. The number of mushrooms in a forest is random though. The gnomes size and shape is irrelevant to the game.
